public_rationale: A CNBC report, syndicated by NBC San Diego and available by 2024-10-29, describes the latest bi-annual survey of the CNBC Technology Executive Council (e1). The respondents were asked whether Copilot had been worth the cost, given as $30 monthly per user (e1). One quarter said yes, one quarter said no, and 50% said it was still too soon to know (e1). Marcus wrote that 25% thought it was worth it, another quarter said it was not, and half said it was too soon to tell. The figures CNBC reported match his.
limitations: The CNBC report does not give the sample size.
The quoted report text does not give the dates the survey was conducted.
The respondents were tech executives on CNBC's Technology Executive Council. The evidence does not show whether they represent Copilot customers in general.
The question asked whether Copilot was worth its cost. It did not ask about general satisfaction or usefulness.
